packs.name: Lucy, the Daughter of the Devil

modules.name: Fortunes
modules.desc: Offline smart fortunes and speech bubbles, picked contextually by a bundled bge-small embedding model. Ships a built-in corpus of ~10,000 lines, so it has something to say before you download a single pack.

modules.name: AI Brain
modules.desc: An optional, off-by-default screen-commentary AI brain (local Ollama/llama.cpp or an optional cloud provider). Reads the screen with Windows' built-in OCR, so it needs no separate Tesseract install.
modules.permissions: Speech, Animation, ScreenContext, Network, Hotkey, Storage

modules.name: Pet Studio
modules.desc: Check a pet's animations.xml before you use it: what the host would reject, which animations can never play, and how it actually looks running on your desktop. Edit the XML in place, watch any animation's real sprite frames, preview the pet temporarily on your desktop, then install it.

modules.name: Reminder
modules.desc: Your pet announces upcoming calendar events and reads your agenda. Watches up to five calendars (local file, ICS URL, or running Outlook), each with its own name, style, and chime; one-click Join for Teams/Zoom/Meet links; a daily morning briefing; typed personal reminders; skips declined and all-day events; lead times, quiet hours, and hush-while-presenting.

modules.name: Remembrance
modules.desc: Records a meeting (your microphone + the system output over WASAPI loopback), transcribes it offline with a local Whisper, names it from your calendar (via the Reminder module) or a timestamp, snapshots the screen on a hotkey, and purges the audio + snapshots after 72 hours while keeping the transcript. Needs a local Whisper (whisper-cli + a model) set up in options, and the machine's own console - a Remote Desktop session presents no real microphone.
modules.permissions: Microphone, SystemAudio, ScreenContext, Hotkey, Storage, Network
